description: Native Windows runtime for SlimLO DOCX-to-PDF converter. Contains a minimal LibreOffice engine (mergedlo.dll), the SlimLO C API (slimlo.dll), and the slimlo_worker.exe process for x64 and ARM64. Built from vanilla LibreOffice source with 30 idempotent patch scripts that strip the engine to its Writer + UNO + PDF export path. Requires Visual C++ Redistributable 2022.
